name: Master Services Agreement (MSA)
description: A master services agreement between a provider and a customer that governs one or more statements of work.

variables.label: Services Summary
variables.description: High-level description of the services covered.

variables.label: Liability Cap Basis
variables.default: the fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim

sections.heading: Parties
sections.body: This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective_date}} between {{provider_name}}, located at {{provider_address}} (the "Provider"), and {{customer_name}}, located at {{customer_address}} (the "Customer").

sections.heading: 1. Services
sections.body: The Provider will perform the services described in one or more statements of work (each, an "SOW") executed under this Agreement. The general scope is: {{services_summary}}. Each SOW is incorporated into and governed by this Agreement.

sections.heading: 2. Fees and Payment
sections.body: The Customer will pay the fees set out in each SOW. Undisputed invoices are payable within {{payment_terms_days}} days of the invoice date. Late amounts may accrue interest at the lower of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

sections.heading: 3. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Each Party retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property. Unless an SOW states otherwise, deliverables created specifically for the Customer become the Customer's property upon full payment, excluding the Provider's pre-existing and general-purpose tools and know-how.

sections.heading: 4. Confidentiality
sections.body: Each Party will protect the other's Confidential Information with at least reasonable care and use it only to perform or receive the services under this Agreement.

sections.heading: 5. Warranties and Disclaimer
sections.body: The Provider warrants that the services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Except as expressly stated, the services are provided "as is" and all other warranties are disclaimed to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Except for confidentiality breaches and indemnification obligations, each Party's total liability is limited to {{liability_cap_basis}}.

sections.heading: 7. Term and Termination
sections.body: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of {{term_months}} months, renewing automatically unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal. Either Party may terminate for material breach that remains uncured 30 days after written notice.

sections.heading: 8. Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the {{governing_law}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.
